commands.step: Restore the soak ledger from the latest retained run
commands.command:
ledger=tools/gomad3/.toolchain/soak/ledger
for run in $(gh run list --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --workflow gomad3.yml --branch "$GITHUB_REF_NAME" --limit 50 \
  --json databaseId,event --jq '.[] | select(.event == "schedule" or .event == "workflow_dispatch") | .databaseId'); do
  test "$run" = "$GITHUB_RUN_ID" && continue
  rm -rf "$ledger"
  if gh run download "$run" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --name "$GOMAD3_SOAK_LEDGER_ARTIFACT" --dir "$ledger"; then
    echo "Restored the soak ledger from run $run"
    exit 0
  fi
done
rm -rf "$ledger"
echo "No retained soak ledger; this run starts new cohorts"
